native_retrieval.title: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh Sworn In As Judge Of Kerala High Court
native_retrieval.snippet: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh was sworn in as a Judge of the Kerala High Court today. Justice Singh has been transferred from the Allahabad High Court.

native_retrieval.title: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh Sworn In As Kerala HC Judge
native_retrieval.snippet: Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh on Friday sworn in as a Judge of the Kerala High Court #Justicedineshkumarsingh #judge #keralahighcourt #legally

native_retrieval.title: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh
native_retrieval.snippet: Appointed as Additional Judge on Sep 22, 2017. Took oath as Permanent Judge on Sep 06, 2019. Took oath as Judge of Kerala High Court on 21.07.2023.

native_retrieval.title: Centre notifies transfer of Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh from Kerala to ...
native_retrieval.snippet: The Central government on July 14 notified the transfer of Justice Dinesh Kumar Singh from Kerala High Court to Karnataka High Court

native_retrieval.title: D:\Drivers\ILR\ILR Files\Speeches of Hon'ble Judges\Farewell to D.K. ...
native_retrieval.snippet: K. Singh, Esteemed Sister and Brother Judges, The Advocate General law officers of the State, Union of India andUnion Territory Chairman, Bar Council of Kerala, President Kerala High Court Advocates’ Association, President, Senior Advocates’ Association, President Kerala Federation of Women Lawyers, Senior Advocates, Members of the Bar, Mrs. Archana Singh, Members of the Advocates’ Clerks’ Association, Ladies and 2025] KERALA SERIES 8 Gentlemen, Today we have assembled to bid farewell to a distinguished Judge of this Court, Justice D.K. Singh,as he takes on his new role at the High Court of Karnataka, marking yet another milestone in his illustrious career.
